## Progress

- Added [Chapter2OverOpen.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/Curves/Hartshorne/HartshorneLib/Chapter2OverOpen.lean), exposing cohomology over opens and restriction/terminal comparison APIs. Commit `c13ca9b3fd`.
- Added [Chapter2MayerVietoris.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/Curves/Hartshorne/HartshorneLib/Chapter2MayerVietoris.lean), with generic module Mayer–Vietoris exactness and the H¹ cokernel equivalence. Commits `f478dc5663`, `d6a844131d`.
- Added [Chapter2TwoCover.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/Curves/Hartshorne/HartshorneLib/Chapter2TwoCover.lean) and umbrella exports for the canonical two-open H¹ bridge. Commit `52641df4ab`.
- Extended [Chapter4CechTwoCover.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/Curves/Hartshorne/HartshorneLib/Chapter4CechTwoCover.lean) with explicit quotient-finiteness transport. Commit `534f133d88`.
- `lake build HartshorneLib` and the configured Horizon check pass all 8620 jobs. LSP diagnostics and the forbidden-token scan are clean; representative axiom verification reports only standard Lean axioms.
- Hgraph synchronization is stale-free: 499 blueprint nodes, 722 Lean declarations, and 294 generated edges. Existing unattached declarations and edge conflicts remain frozen-blueprint traceability debt.

## Issues

The geometric affine H¹ vanishing input, P¹ restriction, and unconditional II.6.10 product formula remain open. The pre-existing `Chapter2ChiSlice` header warning remains. Three optional LSP axiom queries timed out under shared host contention, but the kernel build and representative verification passed.

Janitor found no safe cross-project inbox/task cleanup. Coordination thread `I-2168` is acknowledged with no unread state; its archive command was bounded by filesystem contention and remains ownership-gated.

## Why I stopped

This standing task is partly advanced, not complete. The verified Hartshorne source paths are clean, and the task remains `running` as required.

## Next

Instantiate the two-cover bridge with genuine affine H¹ vanishing, connect it to the Laurent Cech hypotheses, and then pursue the residue-weighted product formula.
